mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.course_name, c.description, c.course_type, c.semester, c.location, c.teacher_id, t.real_name as teacher_name, c.assistant_teacher_ids, c.cover_image_url, c.status, c.create_time, c.update_time FROM mg_course c LEFT JOIN mg_teacher t ON c.teacher_id = t.id WHERE c.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND c.is_deleted = 0 AND t.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.create_time DESC

SELECT c.id, c.course_name, c.description, c.course_type, c.semester, c.location, c.teacher_id, t.real_name as teacher_name, c.assistant_teacher_ids, c.cover_image_url, c.status, c.create_time, c.update_time FROM mg_course c LEFT JOIN mg_teacher t ON c.teacher_id = t.id WHERE c.is_deleted = 0 AND t.is_deleted = 0 AND c.id NOT IN ( SELECT course_id FROM mg_student_course WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND status = 0 ) ORDER BY c.create_time DESC

SELECT c.id, c.course_name, c.description, c.course_type, c.semester, c.location, c.teacher_id, t.real_name as teacher_name, c.assistant_teacher_ids, c.cover_image_url, c.status, c.create_time, c.update_time FROM mg_course c LEFT JOIN mg_teacher t ON c.teacher_id = t.id WHERE c.id = #{courseId} AND c.is_deleted = 0 AND t.is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE mg_course SET update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{courseId} AND is_deleted = 0
